question: What conduct should the practitioner adopt after gaining evenness of mind through practice?
premises: Practice leads to evenness of mind.
Village dharma represents conventional social obligations.
The practitioner is instructed to abandon such obligations.
inference: Through practice one becomes even-minded and should abandon the dharma of village life.
uncertainties: grāma dharmañ may refer broadly to conventional worldly duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the dharma of village life.
